about.title: How Terces works
about.local.title: Your photo stays on your phone
about.local.body: The photo is opened, scanned and cloaked inside this page, in memory. It is never uploaded. When you start over or close the page, it is released.
about.check.title: How to check it yourself
about.check.offline: Airplane mode: after one visit, turn the network off and reload. Everything still works, because nothing needs a server.
about.check.csp: Content Security Policy: the site is only allowed to talk to its own address. You can read the policy in your browser's developer tools.
about.check.source: Source code: all of it is public, so these claims can be checked.
about.count.title: What we count
about.count.body: The only thing that ever leaves your device is a bare tick with no identifier, sent to this site's own address when a photo is scanned and when a cloaked photo is produced:
about.count.stored: The server keeps one daily total per event: day, event, count. Nothing else.
about.count.never: Never stored: IP addresses, identifiers, cookies, device details, or anything about your photo. Nothing is sent while you are offline.
about.limits.title: What it cannot promise
about.limits.body: Detectors can miss things. Terces tells you what it found, and lets you draw over anything else. Look at the result before you share it.
about.models.title: Models and data
about.models.map: Map outlines: Natural Earth (public domain). Town names: GeoNames, CC BY 4.0.

hero.caption: Example image, AI-generated
how.title: Three steps. All on your phone.
how.scanBody: Small AI models run on your device. They read the hidden metadata and find faces, text, plates and people.
how.cloakBody: All metadata is stripped. Faces and text get solid masks that cannot be undone. Tap a zone to keep it, or draw your own.
how.shareBody: The exact output file is checked byte by byte before you can share or save it. No metadata gets through.
gives.title: Nine ways a photo talks.
gives.lead: The scan looks for all of these on your device, in seconds, without a network.
gives.locationValue: GPS coordinates, precise to a few metres
gives.serialValue: Unique IDs that link your photos together
gives.facesValue: Customers, passers-by, kids in the background
gives.textValue: Shop names, street signs, name tags
